notes.title: 100 KILLS CHALLENGE: ORIGINS Will be released on April 8th at 9am PT for free.
notes.content: 100 KILLS CHALLENGE: ORIGINS Will be released on April 8th at 9am PT for free. All FPS players are welcome to come and try it out! Currently, only the deathmatch mode is open, and the number of weapons, maps, and characters is not too rich. If you are satisfied with the gameplay of this game, you can pay attention to the official version, which will be released on April 15. In addition, whoever can kill 100 times and 0 death in PVP or PVE will be my master! What are you waiting for? Just pick up a gun and shoot anyone you see!
